common: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing. Background score for a documentary narration: steady, uncluttered, no sudden loud hits, mixed so a voice can sit on top. Clean professional studio recording.

beds.noir: 1950s film-noir detective jazz: walking upright bass, brushed snare, soft muted trumpet and sparse piano, mysterious investigation mood, slow tempo
beds.lounge: 1950s Las Vegas casino lounge jazz: swinging brushed drums, upright bass, vibraphone and a sly muted trumpet, playful glamorous evening mood, medium tempo
beds.slots: retro casino slot-machine floor: twinkling celesta and vibraphone arpeggios over a bouncy bass, hypnotic and a little dizzy, looping feel
beds.tension: suspense underscore: low pulsing strings, soft ticking percussion, minor key, slowly building tension, cinematic documentary
beds.curious: light curious science-explainer underscore: pizzicato strings, marimba and clarinet, inquisitive and gently playful
beds.serious: serious reflective reveal underscore: slow piano and low cello, weighty and thoughtful, cinematic documentary
beds.finale: warm confident 1950s big-band swing finale: brass section, swinging drums, upbeat satisfying resolution

stings.fanfare: a short triumphant brass fanfare with a cymbal crash, like a 1950s game-show win, then silence
stings.reveal: a short dramatic orchestral 'dun-dun' brass and timpani sting for a revelation, then silence
stings.closed: a short brass chord with a big timpani hit, like a rubber stamp slamming a case closed in a 1950s detective film, then silence
stings.jackpot: a short twinkling slot-machine jackpot jingle with bells, then silence
